item.title: Did French President Macron Blame Indian Air Force For ‘Billion Dollar Rafale Market Loss’?

item.title: Did Manipur Declare Freedom from India? Here’s The Truth Behind Viral Clip
item.description: The footage dates back to 2019 and is connected to the announcement of a so-called “government in exile” by separatist leaders in London at that time. It has no link to the current situation in Manipur.

item.title: Viral Video Of Thar Hanging From NH-48 Signboard Is AI-Generated, Not Real Accident
